tolerance.rationale: Pre-registered 2026-09-27, before any campaign run: the owner's belief that the time step barely matters, made testable. Two successive time steps of one solver at one dx 'agree' when no point moves by more than 1 ms: a fifth of the cross-solver bar, so a time-step effect inside it cannot by itself decide a cross-solver verdict, and 20 times the coarsest step (0.05 ms), so the step's own quantisation of the 0 mV crossing cannot fail it. Seen before: openCARP P8 moved 0.19 ms between dt 50 and 10 us at dx 0.5 mm with lumped mass (opencarp.md G4, G9); cardiacFOAM's time-step effect has not been measured
